classification.difficultyReason: Reduce two different exponential bases and use scaled elimination.

content.prompt:
Solve the following equations simultaneously for $x$ and $y$.
$$\begin{aligned}3^{x+2y}&=81\\2^{2x-y}&=8\end{aligned}$$

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}3^{x+2y}&=3^4\\2^{2x-y}&=2^3\\x+2y&=4\\2x-y&=3\end{align*}$$
Add the first linear equation to twice the second.
$$\begin{align*}(x+2y)+2(2x-y)&=4+2(3)\\5x&=10\\x&=2\\2+2y&=4\\2y&=2\\y&=1\end{align*}$$
